enumerate_attribute_value: generate all combinations of attribute values and split into train or test sets using hash-based filtering
one_hotify: convert a list of attribute value configurations into one-hot encoded PyTorch tensors for each configuration
AttributeValueData: create a PyTorch dataset of attribute-value combinations with optional one-hot encoding and configurable repetition multiplier
SphereData: generate random 2D points on a unit disk with both Cartesian and polar coordinate representations
review_dataset_classes: review the AttributeValueData and SphereData classes to understand their PyTorch dataset interface and data generation logic
